subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this remain a core Gateway/security issue pending redacted Trim OS protocol logs, or should the package-managed config regeneration be routed outside this repository?
rationale: The possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing, shared auth, and a package manager that is not present in this source tree, so automation should not choose an auth-bypass or package-policy direction.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the failing connect frame's protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If the logs show current OpenClaw clients emit opaque or wrong protocol/auth data, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic or protocol path without weakening pairing.

options.title: Route package config externally
options.body: If only `trim.openclaw` rewrites config outside this repository, keep core auth behavior unchanged and route config management to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the failing connect frame's protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Gateway protocol compatibility, gateway-client packaging, and device pairing docs.
